verdict.rationale: Foreloop documents an embeddable widget, but it collects user feedback: its key carries only the signal:write scope and can submit feedback and nothing else. There is no evidence of a changelog or release-notes widget for showing product updates to users. The feedback widget is an adjacent feature and earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can showcase new updates within my product using an embeddable changelog widget
